description: Test fixture for issue #337 round three: an operator-authored dataset whose interaction NOTE does not restate the rating. DrugReference.Interaction.severity and .note are independent fields bound straight from the file, and DrugReferenceInjector.renderFinding writes none of the rating itself — on the bundled DDInter data the rating reaches the model only because DdiDrugReferenceSource.noteFor prepends '<Severity>. ' to the mechanism. Here nothing does, so the record the model reads carries no rating, and an answer cannot have dropped one it was never given.

interactions.note: Coadministration may increase the risk of bleeding.
